chart.title: Price chart
chart.meta: {{interval}} · {{bars}} bars loaded · pan left for older history (pages beyond 1000)
chart.postDelistBanner: Bars after {{date}} are {{source}} — {{exchange}} has no trades. Informational only, not financial advice.

postDelist.title: After delist
postDelist.subtitle: This venue no longer trades the pair. Price below is from another public source — informational only, not financial advice.
postDelist.emptyBody: No public price was found after this venue halted the pair.

stats.stale: last-good supply snapshot (refresh failed or expired)

holders.title: Holders
holders.subtitle: On-chain wallet count and top addresses. Known names (Binance, Bitfinex, …) are public attributions, not identity proof. Informational only — not financial advice.
holders.emptyWallets: Holder count is published, but no top wallets were listed.
holders.stale: Showing last-good snapshot — the holder source is stale or rate-limited.

indicators.title: Technical indicators
indicators.subtitle: RSI({{rsiPeriod}}) · EMA({{emaPeriods}}) · same interval as chart · informational only — not financial advice
indicators.rsiEmpty: No RSI data for this interval.
indicators.fallbackNote: Informational analysis only — not financial advice. RSI uses Wilder smoothing; EMA seeded with SMA.

errors.supply404: Supply snapshot not available for this asset (Binance marketing list coverage).
errors.supplyEquity: Listed stocks do not have a Binance/CoinMarketCap supply snapshot.
errors.holders404: No holder snapshot from CoinMarketCap, GeckoTerminal, or Ethplorer for this asset.
errors.holdersUnmapped: This ticker is not in the marketing catalog and fallback holder sources found no snapshot.
errors.tickerHalted: Last print before halt — not a live 24h window.

pollingPaused: Live refresh paused while this tab is hidden.

tape.title: Futures tape
tape.subtitle: Open interest, funding, liquidations, and CVD from Binance USD-M and Bybit linear. Informational only.
tape.incomplete: Window is incomplete — history is still filling.
tape.liqIncomplete: Liquidation totals only cover time this process has been watching this coin.
tape.unsupported: No perpetual tape for this venue. Showing Binance + Bybit when the same base is listed.
tape.none: No perpetual book for this symbol on Binance or Bybit.

orderBook.title: Order book
orderBook.subtitle: Spot bids and asks, grouped on the server. Walls are large resting size.

orderDepth.title: Market depth
orderDepth.subtitle: Cumulative resting size by price. Green is bids left of mid, red is asks to the right. Same live book as the ladder.

orderHeatmap.title: Liquidity heatmap
orderHeatmap.subtitle: Resting limit-order depth. Green is bids, red is asks, brighter is more size. The wide right column is the current book; history fills to the left. Not executed volume.
orderHeatmap.empty: No live book for this pair.

paperTrade.title: Paper trade
paperTrade.hint: Simulated market fill on your selected paper book. Not real money.
paperTrade.noBook: Create a paper book first on the Paper desk.
